text: You're looking for a high-protein vegan option that can be prepared quickly, and I think I have just the thing. This hummus recipe is not only easy to make and ready in under 10 minutes, but it also packs a significant amount of protein from the garbanzo beans. With 22 grams of protein per serving, it should help you meet your health goal. Plus, it's made with simple, wholesome ingredients that align with your vegan dietary preferences. Give it a try and see how you like it!
